## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of the changes proposed in this pull request and the issue it resolves (if applicable, e.g., `Fixes #12`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Test improvement

## Contributor Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] I have run local verification via `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test.ps1` (or `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...`) and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `README.md` or `docs/`.
- [ ] **Privacy Check:** I have verified that no personal student emails, real names, passwords, tokens, or private cohort data are included in tests, commits, or fixtures.
